annotations.text:
Shipped.
The grid's own row lines ignite from the floor upward in the new level's colour, and the digit hard-cuts with a ghost of the old one. No particles.
Level readout is 2.35rem on mobile (was 1.2rem) and 3.2rem on desktop (was 1.5rem), with a 2px rule under it in the level colour. Score keeps the orange hero slot, lines stay white.
Eight brand hues cover levels 1-8. Nine and ten stay on brand orange and escalate with a glow, orange then white-hot, because the palette has no ninth usable hue on black.
